definition.simple: The practice of keeping places clean and managing human waste properly to prevent diseases.
definition.academic: Public health conditions related to clean drinking water and adequate treatment and disposal of human excreta and sewage to prevent the spread of disease.

examples: Having covered drains in a neighborhood.
Washing hands with soap and using clean toilets.

common_misconceptions: Sanitation only means 'cleaning your house'. It primarily refers to managing waste, garbage, and sewage on a community level.
ai_context.tutor_hint: Ask the student what would happen to the health of a village if there were no toilets and open drains everywhere.
